key_findings.statement: 套餐构成方面，2023年与2024年各套餐注册占比变动有限：2023年各套餐占比介于48.57%至53.33%之间，2024年介于46.67%至51.43%之间，整体构成变化幅度较小。
获客渠道构成方面，2023年各渠道注册占比介于40.38%至56.52%之间，2024年介于43.48%至59.62%之间，渠道构成变化幅度同样有限。
套餐维度下，各套餐流失率变化方向不一：2023年各套餐流失率介于11.76%至38.3%之间，2024年介于11.11%至31.37%之间；流失率变化幅度介于-15.71个百分点至+7.84个百分点之间，存在有升有降的情况。
获客渠道维度下，各渠道流失率变化方向不一：2023年各渠道流失率介于23.08%至52.38%之间，2024年介于19.23%至32.26%之间；流失率变化幅度介于-33.03个百分点至+9.18个百分点之间，同样存在有升有降的情况。

limitations: 分析已达到步骤的硬性上限，未能进一步细分到具体套餐或具体渠道的逐项流失率数值，无法精确判定哪个套餐或渠道对整体流失率下降贡献最大。
套餐构成与获客渠道构成的占比数据仅提供了各维度占比的区间范围，未提供每个具体套餐/渠道的逐项占比数值，无法进行精确的构成对比。

建议进一步获取各具体获客渠道（Outbound、Paid Search、Partner、Organic等）在2023年与2024年的逐项注册数、流失数与流失率，以精确判定哪个渠道的流失率变化驱动了整体差异。

  FROM orders o

  GROUP BY c.city
),
channel_cancel AS (
  SELECT
    o.sales_channel AS dimension_value,
    'channel' AS dimension,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.sales_channel
),
payment_cancel AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method AS dimension_value,
    'payment' AS dimension,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.payment_method
),
all_dims AS (
  SELECT dimension_value, dimension, total_orders, cancelled_orders, cancel_rate FROM city_cancel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dimension_value, dimension, total_orders, cancelled_orders, cancel_rate FROM channel_cancel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dimension_value, dimension, total_orders, cancelled_orders, cancel_rate FROM payment_cancel
),
dim_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dimension,
    MAX(cancel_rate) AS max_rate,
    MIN(cancel_rate) AS min_rate,
    ROUND(MAX(cancel_rate) - MIN(cancel_rate), 2) AS rate_spread,
    ROUND(AVG(cancel_rate), 2) AS avg_rate
  FROM all_dims
  GROUP BY dimension
),
top_dim AS (
  SELECT dimension
  FROM dim_stats
  ORDER BY rate_spread DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_dim_detail AS (
  SELECT
    dimension_value,
    dimension,
    total_orders,
    cancelled_orders,
    cancel_rate
  FROM all_dims
  WHERE dimension = (SELECT dimension FROM top_dim)
),

  SELECT
    CASE WHEN (SELECT dimension FROM top_dim) = 'city' THEN c.city
         WHEN (SELECT dimension FROM top_dim) = 'channel' THEN o.sales_channel
         ELSE o.payment_method END AS dimension_value,
    o.order_date,

    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,

),

  SELECT

    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount

  JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
allocated AS (
  SELECT
    pm.category,
    pm.units_sold,
    pm.revenue,
    pm.order_count,
    COALESCE(rm.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
    COALESCE(rm.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount
  FROM product_metrics AS pm
  LEFT JOIN refund_metrics AS rm ON rm.product_id = pm.product_id
)
SELECT

  SUM(units_sold) AS units_sold,
  SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
  SUM(refund_count) AS refund_count,
  SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(refund_count) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct
